args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks (error rate 0.18) across all production regions following the latest deploy. I rolled out v2.3.0 — the most release that was healthy in production — to us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all three regions with an error rate of 0.002. Remaining follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before re-attempting the release.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: Latest deploy v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (no change-manager approval required since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production history).
3. **Verified**: Service confirmed healthy in all regions post-rollback, error rate dropped to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed describing the failure and the rollback; on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommended: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before the next release attempt.
